youtube.title: Why Did Apple Take Microsoft's Money in 1997?
youtube.description:
In 1997 Apple was losing more than a billion dollars a year, and Steve Jobs later said it was about ninety days from bankruptcy. Then it took $150 million from Microsoft, the rival it had fought in court for a decade, and its own fans booed on stage.

This documentary shows what the deal really traded (the money, the promise to keep Office on the Mac, the browser, the lawsuits), who doubted it, and how the time it bought paid for the iMac, the iPod and the iPhone, until Apple overtook Microsoft itself.

{CHAPTERS}
